question: What is the average loan amount by grade?
gold_sql: SELECT l.grade, AVG(l.loan_amnt) AS average_loan_amount FROM fact_loan f JOIN dim_loan l ON l.loan_key=f.loan_key WHERE l.grade IS NOT NULL GROUP BY l.grade ORDER BY l.grade

question: What is the average interest rate by grade?
gold_sql: SELECT l.grade, AVG(l.int_rate) AS average_interest_rate FROM fact_loan f JOIN dim_loan l ON l.loan_key=f.loan_key WHERE l.grade IS NOT NULL GROUP BY l.grade ORDER BY l.grade

question: What is the average interest rate by grade and loan status?
gold_sql: SELECT l.grade, o.loan_status, AVG(l.int_rate) AS average_interest_rate FROM fact_loan f JOIN dim_loan l ON l.loan_key=f.loan_key JOIN dim_outcome o ON o.outcome_key=f.outcome_key WHERE l.grade IS NOT NULL GROUP BY l.grade, o.loan_status ORDER BY l.grade, o.loan_status

question: What is the total loan amount by grade?
gold_sql: SELECT l.grade, ROUND(SUM(l.loan_amnt), 2) AS total_loan_amount FROM fact_loan f JOIN dim_loan l ON l.loan_key=f.loan_key WHERE l.grade IS NOT NULL GROUP BY l.grade ORDER BY l.grade

question: How many loans were issued by grade?
gold_sql: SELECT l.grade, COUNT(*) AS loan_count FROM fact_loan f JOIN dim_loan l ON l.loan_key=f.loan_key WHERE l.grade IS NOT NULL GROUP BY l.grade ORDER BY l.grade

question: What is the default rate by grade?
gold_sql: SELECT l.grade, ROUND(100.0 * AVG(o.default_flag), 2) AS default_rate_percent FROM fact_loan f JOIN dim_loan l ON l.loan_key=f.loan_key JOIN dim_outcome o ON o.outcome_key=f.outcome_key WHERE l.grade IS NOT NULL GROUP BY l.grade ORDER BY l.grade

question: What is the average monthly installment by grade?
gold_sql: SELECT l.grade, ROUND(AVG(l.installment), 2) AS average_installment FROM fact_loan f JOIN dim_loan l ON l.loan_key=f.loan_key WHERE l.grade IS NOT NULL GROUP BY l.grade ORDER BY l.grade

question: What is the default rate by risk tier?
gold_sql: SELECT g.risk_tier, ROUND(100.0 * AVG(o.default_flag), 2) AS default_rate_percent FROM fact_loan f JOIN dim_loan_grade g ON g.grade_key=f.grade_key JOIN dim_outcome o ON o.outcome_key=f.outcome_key GROUP BY g.risk_tier ORDER BY g.risk_tier

question: How many loans were issued by year?
gold_sql: SELECT d.year, COUNT(*) AS loan_count FROM fact_loan f JOIN dim_date d ON d.date_key=f.date_key GROUP BY d.year ORDER BY d.year

question: What is the default rate by year?
gold_sql: SELECT d.year, ROUND(100.0 * AVG(o.default_flag), 2) AS default_rate_percent FROM fact_loan f JOIN dim_date d ON d.date_key=f.date_key JOIN dim_outcome o ON o.outcome_key=f.outcome_key GROUP BY d.year ORDER BY d.year

question: Show the quarterly trend of fully paid and charged-off loans.
gold_sql: SELECT d.year, d.quarter, o.loan_status, COUNT(*) AS loan_count FROM fact_loan f JOIN dim_date d ON d.date_key=f.date_key JOIN dim_outcome o ON o.outcome_key=f.outcome_key GROUP BY d.year, d.quarter, o.loan_status ORDER BY d.year, d.quarter, o.loan_status

question: Which FICO bands have the highest charge-off rate?
gold_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN b.fico_range_low < 660 THEN 'Sub-660' WHEN b.fico_range_low < 700 THEN '660-699' WHEN b.fico_range_low < 740 THEN '700-739' ELSE '740+' END AS fico_band, ROUND(100.0 * AVG(o.default_flag), 2) AS default_rate_percent FROM fact_loan f JOIN dim_borrower b ON b.borrower_key=f.borrower_key JOIN dim_outcome o ON o.outcome_key=f.outcome_key GROUP BY fico_band ORDER BY default_rate_percent DESC

question: What is the default rate by DTI band?
gold_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN b.dti < 10 THEN 'Low (<10)' WHEN b.dti < 20 THEN 'Moderate (10-19.9)' WHEN b.dti < 30 THEN 'Elevated (20-29.9)' ELSE 'High (30+)' END AS dti_band, ROUND(100.0 * AVG(o.default_flag), 2) AS default_rate_percent FROM fact_loan f JOIN dim_borrower b ON b.borrower_key=f.borrower_key JOIN dim_outcome o ON o.outcome_key=f.outcome_key GROUP BY dti_band ORDER BY dti_band

question: What is the default rate by income bracket?
gold_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN b.annual_inc < 50000 THEN '<50K' WHEN b.annual_inc < 100000 THEN '50K-99K' WHEN b.annual_inc < 150000 THEN '100K-149K' ELSE '150K+' END AS income_band, ROUND(100.0 * AVG(o.default_flag), 2) AS default_rate_percent FROM fact_loan f JOIN dim_borrower b ON b.borrower_key=f.borrower_key JOIN dim_outcome o ON o.outcome_key=f.outcome_key GROUP BY income_band ORDER BY income_band

question: What is the total principal received by loan status?
gold_sql: SELECT o.loan_status, SUM(f.total_rec_prncp) AS total_principal_received FROM fact_loan f JOIN dim_outcome o ON o.outcome_key=f.outcome_key GROUP BY o.loan_status ORDER BY o.loan_status

question: What is the total principal received by grade?
gold_sql: SELECT l.grade, SUM(f.total_rec_prncp) AS total_principal_received FROM fact_loan f JOIN dim_loan l ON l.loan_key=f.loan_key WHERE l.grade IS NOT NULL GROUP BY l.grade ORDER BY l.grade

question: What is the total principal received by year?
gold_sql: SELECT d.year, SUM(f.total_rec_prncp) AS total_principal_received FROM fact_loan f JOIN dim_date d ON d.date_key=f.date_key GROUP BY d.year ORDER BY d.year

question: What principal was recovered by grade and issue year?
gold_sql: SELECT l.grade, d.year, ROUND(SUM(f.total_rec_prncp), 2) AS total_principal_received FROM fact_loan f JOIN dim_loan l ON l.loan_key=f.loan_key JOIN dim_date d ON d.date_key=f.date_key WHERE l.grade IS NOT NULL GROUP BY l.grade, d.year ORDER BY l.grade, d.year

question: What is the recovery rate on charged off loans by grade?
gold_sql: SELECT l.grade, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(f.total_rec_prncp) / NULLIF(SUM(l.loan_amnt), 0), 2) AS recovery_rate_percent FROM fact_loan f JOIN dim_loan l ON l.loan_key=f.loan_key JOIN dim_outcome o ON o.outcome_key=f.outcome_key WHERE o.loan_status = 'Charged Off' AND l.grade IS NOT NULL GROUP BY l.grade ORDER BY l.grade

question: What is the loss given default (LGD) on charged off loans by year?
gold_sql: SELECT d.year, ROUND(100.0 * (1.0 - SUM(f.total_rec_prncp) / NULLIF(SUM(l.loan_amnt), 0)), 2) AS lgd_percent FROM fact_loan f JOIN dim_loan l ON l.loan_key=f.loan_key JOIN dim_date d ON d.date_key=f.date_key JOIN dim_outcome o ON o.outcome_key=f.outcome_key WHERE o.loan_status = 'Charged Off' GROUP BY d.year ORDER BY d.year

question: What is the average principal recovered on charged off loans by year?
gold_sql: SELECT d.year, ROUND(AVG(f.total_rec_prncp), 2) AS average_principal_received FROM fact_loan f JOIN dim_date d ON d.date_key=f.date_key JOIN dim_outcome o ON o.outcome_key=f.outcome_key WHERE o.loan_status = 'Charged Off' GROUP BY d.year ORDER BY d.year

question: What is the unrecovered principal exposure on charged off loans by grade?
gold_sql: SELECT l.grade, ROUND(SUM(l.loan_amnt - f.total_rec_prncp), 2) AS unrecovered_principal FROM fact_loan f JOIN dim_loan l ON l.loan_key=f.loan_key JOIN dim_outcome o ON o.outcome_key=f.outcome_key WHERE o.loan_status = 'Charged Off' AND l.grade IS NOT NULL GROUP BY l.grade ORDER BY l.grade

question: Which top 3 grades have the highest default rate?
